title: GIG-4387: Ping-Pong Hydra Postmaclone Slots Instead Of Reloading Shared
description: Adds shared.ping_pong so produce builds in the idle database and flips latest.json instead of wiping the live shared copy for a second restore.

test_plan.description: Ping-pong produce promotes idle slot without reloading shared
steps: After release, enable ping_pong on factory hydra and GRANT both users on both databases
Run produce and confirm logs Ping-pong live … building idle … then Promoting … with no Refreshing shared hosted database
Confirm latest.json has shared_database set to the idle slot that was just built
Connect and confirm the session database matches latest.json
Confirm PHPStan is clean (no ?->database ?? on slot names)
Produce logs: no latest.json write between anonymize and dump; Promoting happens after upload with real size/sha256
If latest.json already has shared_database, --from-artifact logs keeping live and does not wipe the other slot
Bootstrap --from-artifact with no shared_database still loads idle using target.remote host/port/url
